title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between South Alabama Jaguars and Fresno State Bulldogs, originally scheduled for Friday, November 27, 2026 at 2:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the South Alabama Jaguars win, the market will resolve to "South Alabama Jaguars".
If the Fresno State Bulldogs win, the market will resolve to "Fresno State Bulldogs".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Sunday, November 29, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
